svg.aria-label: Maria Bravo, Full Stack and Mobile developer in Bilbao, Spain. A pixel art girl codes on her laptop with a wolf pup sitting beside her, next to a terminal that runs docker compose up maria and starts her services: frontend with Angular, React and Ionic; backend with Java, Spring Boot and Python; mobile with Ionic and React Native; devops with Docker, Kubernetes and GitHub Actions; and status: open to work, available now.
